message.text:
SSE is the mechanism. The hub is in server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. Memo handlers that broadcast directly are CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction.

UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations broadcast indirectly via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects.
Server-Sent Events (SSE) is the mechanism. The hub is implemented in sse_hub.go. The memo handlers broadcasting through it have been identified.

q20.
SSE; server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction

The hub is `SSEHub` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (HTTP subscribe path in `sse_handler.go`). Create/Delete/Comment/Reaction handlers call `SSEHub.Broadcast` directly; UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations go through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `memo_update_helpers.go`.
